title: AWS CloudOps Agent Skill Schema (agentskills.io compliant)
description: Schema for SKILL.md YAML frontmatter. Follows the agentskills.io spec with AWS-CloudOps-auditor extensions in metadata (pipeline phase, CloudOps family, verdict shape). Validates the softaworks-pattern frontmatter used by every shipped skill.

name.description: Skill identifier (lowercase, hyphens, must match directory name). Must not start with a digit.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it, including trigger keywords for routing. This is the activation trigger that agents use for skill discovery.

license.description: License name or reference to bundled license file

compatibility.description: Environment requirements (agent runtime, Python version, AWS CLI version, system packages, etc.)

metadata.description: AWS CloudOps agent extensions (all values MUST be strings per agentskills.io spec). Fields: domain (aws-cloudops), task_type, skill_class, lifecycle_status, complexity, family, verdict_shape, phase (string '1'-'4'), requires_llm ('true'/'false'), supports_pipeline ('true'/'false'), entry_point ('true'/'false'), version, author, keywords (comma-joined), tags (comma-joined), dependencies (comma-joined), activation_triggers (comma-joined), when_to_use.

task_type.description: CloudOps task type: audit (assess posture), deploy (provision), troubleshoot (diagnose), optimize (reduce cost/improve perf), operate (day-2 ops), automate (workflow/pipeline).

skill_class.description: Capability = durable knowledge; Preference = temporary, retire as models improve.

author.description: Author or team responsible for the skill

keywords.description: Comma-joined discovery keywords for routing (AWS service names, audit verbs, compliance frameworks)

dependencies.description: Comma-joined other skills this skill routes to or requires
